faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know before your first booking.

trust.question: How do I know a service pro is trustworthy?
trust.answer: Every professional on FindPeople completes ID verification and a background check before they can accept jobs, and their public rating reflects real completed work.

cost.question: How much does it cost to use FindPeople?
cost.answer: Browsing and requesting quotes is completely free. Professionals pay a small service fee only when they complete a paid job.

coverage-area.question: Which areas does FindPeople currently serve?
coverage-area.answer: We're live across Dhaka and expanding to more cities soon.

unhappy.question: What happens if I'm not happy with the service?
unhappy.answer: Reach out to our support team within 48 hours of the job and we'll help make it right, including arranging a redo with the provider.

payments.question: How do payments work?
payments.answer: FindPeople doesn't process payments. The rate you see is a starting estimate — you and the provider agree on a final price directly, and you pay them in cash once the job is complete.

recurring.question: Can I book the same pro for recurring service?
recurring.answer: Yes — after your first job, you can rebook the same professional directly from your history.

mobile-app.question: Is there a FindPeople mobile app?
mobile-app.answer: Yes, the FindPeople app is available on Android and iOS with the same booking experience as the website.
